newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sirti H1 1996 pretax profit up.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sirti H1 1996 pretax profit up.

text.p: Sirti SpA,the cable-laying unit of state telecoms holding Stet, said it posted first half 1996 pre-tax profit of around 105 billion lire against 91 billion in the same 1995 period.
Operating profit rose to 59 billion lire from 47.8 billion and total revenues increased to 601 billion lire from 548 billion, the company said in a statement.

Sirti, whose privatisation is on the cards some time in the near future, said that for the full 1996 year it expected to be able to confirm the better trend "despite a general picture which is still full of uncertainties."
